{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000003EYWXN9NRMKXD","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x256
group entry "Entry" {
  node Entry "CanvasPlugin" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/CanvasPlugin.ts" color=violet
  node Meta "meta" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/meta.ts"
  node Body "plugin.tsx" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/plugin.tsx"
}
group caps "Capabilities" {
  node Surface "react-surface" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/capabilities/react-surface.tsx" color=blue
  node GraphBuilder "app-graph-builder" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/capabilities/app-graph-builder.ts"
  node Settings "settings" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/capabilities/settings.ts"
  node OpHandler "operation-handler" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-chess/src/capabilities/operation-handler.ts"
}
group code "Code" color=light-violet {
  node Ops "Operations" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-chess/src/operations" color=light-red
  node Containers "Containers" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/containers"
  node Model "Model" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/model" color=green
  node Types "Types/Schema" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/types"
  node UiPkg "react-ui-canvas" ref="packages/ui/react-ui-canvas" color=blue
}
edge Entry -> Meta
edge Entry composes Body "lazy import"
edge Body composes Surface
edge Body composes GraphBuilder
edge Body composes Settings
edge Body composes OpHandler
edge OpHandler -> Ops
edge Surface -> Containers "renders"
edge Containers -> UiPkg
edge Containers -> Model
edge GraphBuilder -> Types
edge Settings -> Types
